Amy (Sales): Heads-up: Northwell asking for a 2-week POC. Requirements: Go SDK, streaming responses, function/tool calls to their inventory microservice, strict JSON schema enforcement, EU data residency, BYOK. Can we do this?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Yes. Need clarity on sync vs async toolcalls and expected token sizes. They want partial tokens for UI and final function args validated.
Amy (Sales): They said interactive chat -> toolcall 'check_inventory' that returns {action, payload}. No prose around the JSON, must be machine-parseable. p95 latency target ~250ms.
Helena (Infra): For residency + latency, Dedicated in eu-west is recommended. Sustained ~160-200 qps needs reserved capacity; spikes up to ~900 qps require burst addon or autoscale. Sandbox provisioning ETA ~72 hours after contact info/IP ranges.
Theo (Security): BYOK supported on Private. Need KMS ARN, rotation cadence, and retention policy. Also send SOC2 report and complete presales security questionnaire. ops-bot: https://redwood.internal/sec/presales-poc
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Go SDK pattern: Stream tokens, detect EventFunctionCall, accumulate args until FunctionComplete, then call their API. Suggest response_schema with "enforce":true so runtime rejects nonconforming output. App should still validate to avoid retries.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick pseudo snippet: ```go
client.Stream(ctx, req, func(evt Event){
  if evt.Type == EventFunctionCall { /* buffer until complete */ }
  if evt.Type == EventToken { /* render partial token */ }
})
```
Amy (Sales): Pricing: they asked for a ballpark for a 2-week sandbox (dedicated + burst).
Helena (Infra): Rough sketch: pro-rated reserved capacity ~$2k for 2 weeks + burst addon ~+20-30%. SE time 6-10 hours. Finance to confirm.
Theo (Security): I'll email SOC2 artifacts and request questionnaire answers. Also flag backup retention gap for prod.
Amy (Sales): Action items: 1) I'll collect IP ranges and SAML metadata today. 2) Ravi to prepare Go demo repo and schema example. 3) Helena to queue sandbox once we have contact. 4) Theo to send security pack. Demo slot requested Wed 11:00 CET.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 48h for security checklist and sandbox status.
Amy (Sales): Thanks team — I'll post customer schema sample when I get it and confirm the demo.
